notes: Cover: 64 x 48 x 5 mm sole; four hooked corners, 54 x 38 mm foot envelope.
Two bars: separate spring sliders; 3.0 mm travel, 1.0 mm captive guide pins.
Per slider: 1 extension spring, nominal 0.50 N/mm; no initial tension target.
Fit sliding tongues to 0.20 mm clearance per side. Deburr 1.1 mm pin holes.
Reference spring envelope: OD <= 2.0 mm; install between end-14 and end-19 pins.
The spring hooks must fit the 5 mm neutral anchor span and 8 mm extended span.
Spring force is a design target; select/test the assembled spring, not wire colour.
